card.name: Verbs and pronouns in narrative prose
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a clause in older narrative or memoir prose, such as a verb or pronoun right after the subject ("recognized it", "could be seen", "looks up"). Also fires on a digit inside a number.

modes.label: Clause-internal verbs and pronouns
modes.description: A verb or object pronoun in the middle of a literary or historical sentence, before the clause continues.
modes.example: but I recognized<< it>> immediately as a state of affairs worth fighting

modes.label: Digits inside numbers
modes.description: A single digit partway through a number such as a frequency or a year.
modes.example: The tone is sent at a level of <<1>>050 Hz and will set off

card.writes: It slightly favors adverbs like "now", "moreover", "sometimes" and "somehow" as the next word, in English, Spanish and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on mid-sentence words in old-fashioned storytelling, where an adverb like "now" or "sometimes" could come next.
